com.sun.org.apache.xalan.internal.utils

类 XMLSecurityManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.org.apache.xalan.internal.utils.XMLSecurityManager

  • public final class XMLSecurityManager
extends Object
    This class is not the same as that in Xerces. It is used to manage the state of corresponding Xerces properties and pass the values over to the Xerces Security Manager.
    作者:
    Joe Wang Oracle Corp.
